title: PREBLE: EFFICIENT DISTRIBUTED PROMPT SCHEDULING FOR LLM SERVING
authors: Vikranth Srivatsa; Zijian He; Reyna Abhyankar; Dongming Li; Yiying Zhang
affiliations: University of California, San Diego, GenseeAI Inc.

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems are not prompt-cache-aware in distributed environments, leading to inefficient KV computation and load imbalance when requests with shared prefixes are distributed across different GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM 服務系統在分散式環境中缺乏對 prompt cache 的感知，導致具有共享前綴的 request 被分散到不同 GPU 時，KV 計算效率低落且負載失衡。

key_innovation.en: Preble, a distributed LLM serving platform featuring the E2 (Exploitation + Exploration) scheduling algorithm that co-optimizes KV state reuse and computation load-balancing through a hierarchical scheduling mechanism.
key_innovation.zh: Preble 是一個分散式 LLM 服務平台，其核心為 E2（Exploitation + Exploration）scheduling 演算法，藉由階層式排程機制同步最佳化 KV 狀態重用與計算負載均衡。

key_improvements.en: 1.5x to 14.5x improvement in average latency and 2x to 10x improvement in p99 latency compared to SGLang.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 SGLang，平均 latency 提升 1.5x 至 14.5x，p99 latency 提升 2x 至 10x。

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: LLM Serving, Tool Calling, Embodied Agents, Code Generation, Video QA, Long Document QA
